title: Electropop
tagline: Electronic textures and synthesizers shaped into concise pop songs.
summary: Electropop uses electronic instruments and studio production as the foundation for pop songwriting. Synthesizers, drum machines, and processed vocals can create sounds that are bright, cool, or experimental while keeping hooks and melody central. The style has moved through many eras, adapting to new technologies and dance-music influences.

pillars.name: Kraftwerk
pillars.why: Kraftwerk's electronic arrangements and melodic repetition strongly influenced the development of synth-based pop.

pillars.name: Depeche Mode
pillars.why: Depeche Mode brought electronic instrumentation and dark, memorable songwriting to a large pop audience.

pillars.name: Pet Shop Boys
pillars.why: Pet Shop Boys paired synth production with sharp lyrics and highly crafted pop melodies.
